|errata_history=This is the original printed card (title and text); the images are the original-sheet card image and the release-sheet slip. The later errata versions are [[Cyborg Commander, Hunter Of Jedi (Errata)]] (PC-E1) and, renamed, [[Grievous, Hunter Of Jedi]] (PC-E2, the current text).
* '''Original''' (this page): printed as “•Cyborg Commander, Hunter Of Jedi” (lore “Leader. “He’s no Jedi.””), text as given in the Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet (official text as of 18 June 2010; the surviving copy was re-made 28 July 2010)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 18 June 2010"; copy re-made 28 July 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174512/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “[Virtual Block 5] Dark Jedi Lightsaber may deploy on Cyborg Commander. Jedi present are power -1 (-2 if a Jedi Council Member). While armed with a lightsaber, your battle destiny draws here are +1 and his forfeit may not be reduced. Immune to attrition < 4.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-01-Grievous_Hunter_Of_Jedi.png]], named after the later title) and the original-sheet card image ([[:File:VL-history-1271-1-front-original.png]]) print it.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Cyborg Commander, Hunter Of Jedi (Errata)]]): the PC website card list (from 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, to 11 January 2013), still under the title “Cyborg Commander, Hunter Of Jedi”, shows “may deploy on Cyborg.” and “your battle destiny draws are +1 here and Cyborg Commander's forfeit may not be reduced”<ref name="cl-VBlock7-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 21 July 2012] (Internet Archive); same text in every capture to [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 11 January 2013]</ref>: “[Virtual Block 5] Dark Jedi Lightsaber may deploy on Cyborg. Jedi present are power -1 (-2 if a Jedi Council Member). While armed with a lightsaber, your battle destiny draws are +1 here and Cyborg Commander's forfeit may not be reduced. Immune to attrition < 4.” No published card image shows this text; the image of that page is a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB7-01-Cyborg_Commander_Hunter_Of_Jedi-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Grievous, Hunter Of Jedi]]): on 29 January 2013 the [[Players Committee]] announced the persona-name change “Cyborg Commander ---> Grievous”, effective immediately (old slips stayed tournament-legal; non-gameplay lore was removed)<ref name="persona2013">[https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003512/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 New Persona Changes], [[Players Committee]], 29 January 2013. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003512/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 Internet Archive].</ref>. The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints the card as “•Grievous, Hunter Of Jedi” (lore “Commander. Leader.”) with the release-sheet wording otherwise restored<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “[Virtual Block 5] Dark Jedi Lightsaber may deploy on Grievous. Jedi present are power -1 (-2 if a Jedi Council Member). While armed with a lightsaber, your battle destiny draws here are +1 and his forfeit may not be reduced. Immune to attrition < 4.” The Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1271-1-front-master.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-grievoushunterofjedi-pre.gif]]) print it.
